arStrings.szText: {c_important}Ball Lightning{/c} now deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_DAMAGE_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage per second. The ball's speed is greatly increased while it is not near enemies.
{c_important}Ball Lightning{/c} orbits you and now deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_DAMAGE_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage around you per second.

{c_important}Ball Lightning{/c} becomes a {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Skill, deals Fire damage, and has a {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} second Cooldown.

{c_important}Ball Lightning{/c} is now cast at the target location and continuously Pulls In enemies, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_DAMAGE_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage over {c_number}[SF_16]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Ball Lightning{/c} has a {c_number}[SF_20 * 100|%|]{/c} chance to form a second {c_important}Ball Lightning{/c}.
{c_important}Ball Lightning{/c} forms {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} {u}{c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} when it dissipates.
{c_important}Ball Lightning{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_24 * 100 |%x|]{/c} increased damage when it hits {c_number}{SF_25}{/c} or fewer enemies.
